newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MCL Corp says bond issue not approved.
newsitem.headline: MCL Corp says bond issue not approved.

text.p: MCL Corp Bhd said that a proposed bond issue has not received the approval of Bank Negara Malaysia, the country's central bank.

In a statement issued late Friday, the company said that it has decided to proceed with a proposed rights issue of 50 million ringgit nominal value of six percent irredeemable convertible unsecured loan stocks in place of the bond issue.
MCL had previously proposed a 50 million ringgit nominal amount of four percent redeemable bank guaranteed bonds with detachable warrants.
It said the loan stocks issue will enable it to secure cheaper fixed medium-term funds to finance a previously-announced proposed acquisition of a retail complex for 59.7 million ringgit.
MCL is involved in property development, the making and wholesaling of fashiong garments, steam laundry and other activities.
